BrushLLM Player 0.0.12 brings playback tools into view and improves local subtitle loading on macOS and Windows.

- Windowed playback shows labeled controls for playback speed, tracks, chapters, and other tools. In fullscreen, move the pointer to the bottom edge to show the controls. They hide again when the pointer leaves.
- Right-click the video to change playback speed. The timeline shows the seek time above the track when you hover.
- Local videos automatically load matching subtitle files from the same folder, including names with language suffixes. Choose all subtitles in the folder or disable auto-loading in subtitle settings.
- File Associations lists the supported formats. On macOS, set BrushLLM Player as the default for all listed formats from Settings. On Windows, open the system Default Apps settings from the player.

| Platform | Installer |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 14 or later, Apple Silicon | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.12-arm64.dmg` |
| Windows, x64 | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.12-x64.exe` |
| Windows, ARM64 | `BrushLLM.Player-0.0.12-arm64.exe` |
